evals.name: run-dashboard-regression-test
evals.prompt: Run regression test for the dashboard page at http://localhost:5173/. The test should: 1) Navigate to the dashboard, 2) Wait for page to load, 3) Check that the dashboard container exists, 4) Verify no console errors, 5) Take a screenshot.
evals.expected_output: Test executes successfully with agent-browser commands: open, wait, snapshot, validate, screenshot. Should return test result showing dashboard loaded successfully with all checks passed.

evals.name: test-games-page
evals.prompt: Test the games list page. Navigate to http://localhost:5173/games, wait for the games grid to load, verify that the search input exists, check for console errors, and capture a screenshot.
evals.expected_output: Successfully executes test using agent-browser CLI. Returns test results showing games page loaded, search input found, no console errors, and screenshot saved.

evals.name: e2e-event-creation
evals.prompt: Run E2E test for event creation workflow. Navigate to http://localhost:5173/events/create, fill in the event name 'test_login', set table name 'ods_test_all_view', select event type 'single', submit the form, and verify success message appears.
evals.expected_output: Executes multi-step E2E test using agent-browser. Fills form fields, clicks submit, waits for success message. Returns test result showing workflow completed successfully.
